facts.label: not_supported
facts.reason: The last ventilator/intubation record ('PEEP set: 5 cmH2O') was 9.7 h before the decision, with none after it. Ventilator settings are charted every 1-4 h while ventilated, so by the rule (> 6 h without a record) the patient was not ventilated at T.

facts.claim_text: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (FiO2 30%, PEEP 5 cmH2O, set RR 12) and monitor respiratory status.
